headline: Clayton beats Price in all-Welsh final to win the New Zealand Darts Masters
standfirst: Jonny Clayton won the World Series event in Auckland, beating Gerwyn Price 8-4 and finishing with a 158 checkout in the final.
body: Jonny Clayton won the New Zealand Darts Masters at Spark Arena in Auckland, beating fellow Welshman Gerwyn Price 8-4 in the final. Price had the slightly higher average, 95.49 to 94.96, but Clayton was more clinical and hit a 158 checkout, the best finish of the event.
Clayton had a narrow escape in his opening match, beating local player Haupai Puha 6-5. He then beat Gian van Veen 6-3 and James Wade 7-2, averaging 98.93 in the semi-finals.

Price beat Damon Heta 6-2 and then Raymond Smith 7-2 to reach the final. Smith had produced the best average of the tournament, 99.81, in his last-16 win over Stephen Bunting, before beating Adam Leek 6-3.
Wade beat Josh Rock 6-4 in his quarter-final, in which Rock hit a 156 checkout.
Price led the 180 count with 12, with Clayton and Smith on eight each.
